description:
Contains the Trees dataset from the Sensitive Habitat Inventory and Mapping (SHIM 2002) project in Summerland from 2008. 
Note: As this data is a snapshot in time and has not been updated since 2008, it may not reflect the current environment. Use with caution. 
"The SHIM Atlas is a land-planning, interactive GIS tool that identifies sensitive aquatic and terrestrial habitats. The Atlas is intended to provide community, stewardship groups, individuals, regional districts and municipalities with an effective" -SHIM Interactive Map. 
For more information visit: [https://www.cmnbc.ca/atlasgallery/shim-sensitive-habitat-inventory-and-mapping/](https://www.cmnbc.ca/atlasgallery/shim-sensitive-habitat-inventory-and-mapping/) 
and for data standards please visit: [https://cmnmaps.ca/cmn/files/methods/SHIM_Methods.html](https://cmnmaps.ca/cmn/files/methods/SHIM_Methods.html) and [https://cmnmaps.ca/cmn/files/methods/SHIM_Manual/SHIM_10Jun02.pdf](https://cmnmaps.ca/cmn/files/methods/SHIM_Manual/SHIM_10Jun02.pdf)
